candidates.review_note: For each possible pattern length 1..10, split positions by residue and letter, with compact Fenwick counts. A query sums matching residue subsequences aligned to l, not global zero. Point mutation adjusts old/new letters in all ten lengths. O(10 log n) per event, O(40n) compact counts.

Minimum-cost flow models original capacities at cost zero and extra capacity on existing pipes at unit cost. Successive shortest augmenting paths include reverse negative-cost arcs, allowing rerouting prior flow. Send full zero-cost bottlenecks, then only additional flow affordable under remaining budget. Never adds nonexistent pipes.

BFS includes wait and four adjacent moves, tests car occupancy at arrival time because moves are simultaneous. Nearest starting lane moves right, alternating upwards. Traffic repeats every m turns, so visited state is cell and time modulo m. Earlier same phase dominates later arrivals; respect absolute round limit and non-wrapping frog.

Distinct real roots are separated by derivative roots. Recursively isolate monotone intervals within [-26,26], which strictly contains the promised roots, then bisect sign changes to convergence. Sort is inherent in interval order. Supports EOF without sentinel and normalizes rounded negative zero.

Parse department header lines separately from seven comma-delimited record fields; preserve all field text and associate each record with its department. Stable sort by last name and format the sample-specified 40-dash header. Handles optional blank separators and EOF immediately after last record.

Determinize the nondeterministic movement process by the set of possible current rows or columns after each digit prefix. Appending a digit maps one subset to a unique opposite-axis subset, so DP counts digit strings once regardless of paths. Precompute nine transitions per subset, alternate horizontal/vertical steps 2N times, omit empty subsets.

Rearrange to x=a*c*y/(d*c-b*y). Positive x requires 1<=y<dc/b, bounded by dc<=1e6. Each such y yields exactly one positive x iff divisibility holds, so exact integer enumeration counts all and only solutions. Empty T allowed, no floating-point equality.
